notes.off_intent: Intent labels are off, so new sessions get none. Turn them on in <link>Settings</link>
notes.off_themes: Theme labels are off, so new sessions get none. Turn them on in <link>Settings</link>
notes.unevaluated_intent: Intent labels are on, but the model’s answers are suggestions until its version passes an evaluation: review sessions below, then evaluate it in <link>Settings</link>
notes.unevaluated_themes: Theme labels are on, but the model’s answers are suggestions until its version passes an evaluation: review sessions below, then evaluate it in <link>Settings</link>

intents.title: Intents
intents.description: What people came for, by session, and how those sessions ended. A session takes the intent of the first labeled turn in it.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description_one: Topics the model named for people’s sessions, grouped when they use the same words. A theme is named only when at least {{count, number}} person had sessions on it in this range; smaller ones are counted together. The hint is the model’s read of the first messages; the outcome is what happened.
themes.description_other: Topics the model named for people’s sessions, grouped when they use the same words. A theme is named only when at least {{count, number}} different people had sessions on it in this range; smaller ones are counted together. The hint is the model’s read of the first messages; the outcome is what happened.
themes.empty: No sessions with themes in this range.

hidden.themes_one: {{count, number}} smaller theme not named: fewer than {{min, number}} people each.
hidden.themes_other: {{count, number}} smaller themes not named: fewer than {{min, number}} people each.
hidden.more_one: {{count, number}} more theme past the first {{shown, number}}.
hidden.more_other: {{count, number}} more themes past the first {{shown, number}}.
hidden.sessions_one: {{count, number}} session is on none of the themes shown.
hidden.sessions_other: {{count, number}} sessions are on none of the themes shown.

review.title: Review
review.description: Sessions the model labeled. Open one to read its title and first messages, scrubbed as the model got them, and set its intent or topics: yours count at once and form the golden set the model is evaluated against. Opening one, and this list, is recorded in the access log.
review.empty-unreviewed: Nothing waits for review. Sessions appear here once the model has labeled them.
review.empty: No session has a label yet.

label.title: Session labels
label.saved: Saved. Themes counts it within a minute.
label.input: What the model reads, scrubbed of contact details and secrets
label.model-intent: The model says {{intent}}, {{confidence, number(style: percent; maximumFractionDigits: 0)}} sure; a suggestion only.
label.model-intent_applied: The model says {{intent}}, {{confidence, number(style: percent; maximumFractionDigits: 0)}} sure; it counts.
label.model-topics: The model says {{topics}} ({{outcome}}), {{confidence, number(style: percent; maximumFractionDigits: 0)}} sure; a suggestion only.
label.model-topics_applied: The model says {{topics}} ({{outcome}}), {{confidence, number(style: percent; maximumFractionDigits: 0)}} sure; it counts.
label.topics-hint: A few plain words each; never a person’s name.
